sharedFormBinding.note: 600-00228 is one official form consumed by seven components in the fee_waiver_application role, each conditional on a fee actually being charged. This is a one-to-many binding, not seven acquisitions.

closedIdentities.note: Not a document. The Judiciary forms library returns no result for the number, its document path returns HTTP 404, and the official archive index holds no capture of it at any time on either Judiciary hostname. It appears only in the prose of the Judiciary's expungement narrative page, whose own hyperlink resolves to the fee-waiver page naming 600-00228. It must not be carried forward as an alternative identity, an acquisition target, a source gap, or an unresolved sibling.

gates.editionAmendmentScope: The adopted Edition 1.2 manifests VT:600-00228:FEE_WAIVER:EN as assetClass supporting_process with packetCandidate false and records no byte count, and the seven component relationships are typed authority_role_mismatch for that reason. The identity is settled; making it worker-assignable requires the successor edition to carry the measurement and to classify a participant-completed fillable application as a packet candidate. That is an edition amendment, and this record does not perform one.
